title: ROS 2 remapping not working and "Couldn't parse remap rule": namespaces, absolute and ~/ names, launch remappings, actions and bag play --remap, measured
excerpt: Which ROS 2 remap rules apply and which are skipped without a warning: absolute rules on namespaced nodes, ~/ names, node-specific rules, launch remappings, actions on Humble, wildcards, bag play --remap and runtime resubscribing. Measured in rclpy on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
